other_conditions: Provider must be approved by the Ministry of Tourism, Government of India, or the concerned State/UT Tourism Department.
Must have shown a minimum fee of ₹1.00 crore–₹2.00 crore in either 2018‑19 or 2019‑20 to be eligible for up to two tours in a financial year.
Must have shown a minimum fee of ₹2.00 crore or more in either 2018‑19 or 2019‑20 to be eligible for up to three tours in a financial year.
Tourism departments of State Governments/UT Administrations are eligible without having to meet the above fee and tour‑count conditions.
benefits_summary: Financial support up to ₹3,50,000 per tour for eligible tourism service providers, up to ₹3,50,000 overall for state tourism departments, and 50% up to ₹1,00,000 per year for online promotion.
